name: mila-desktop
description: Mila, an assistant that runs local LLMs on your own GPU
author: Todd Thomson

scripts.prebuild:windows: node -e "['session/mila-session.exe', 'session/vcruntime140.dll'].every(require('node:fs').existsSync) || (console.error('No session to package: run cmake --install <build directory> --component mila-session --prefix session first.'), process.exit(1))"
scripts.prebuild:linux: node -e "require('node:fs').existsSync('session/mila-session') || (console.error('No session to package: run cmake --install <build directory> --component mila-session --prefix session first.'), process.exit(1))"
scripts.prebuild:mac: node -e "require('node:fs').existsSync('session/mila-session') || (console.error('No session to package: run cmake --install <build directory> --component mila-session --prefix session first.'), process.exit(1))"
scripts.prebuild:mac:signed: node -e "const env = process.env; require('node:fs').existsSync('session/mila-session') || (console.error('No session to package: run cmake --install <build directory> --component mila-session --prefix session first.'), process.exit(1)); env.APPLE_KEYCHAIN_PROFILE || (env.APPLE_API_KEY && env.APPLE_API_KEY_ID && env.APPLE_API_ISSUER) || (env.APPLE_ID && env.APPLE_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD && env.APPLE_TEAM_ID) || (console.error('No notarization credentials: set APPLE_KEYCHAIN_PROFILE to a profile stored with xcrun notarytool store-credentials.'), process.exit(1))"
scripts.postbuild:mac:signed: spctl --assess --type execute -vv "dist/mac-arm64/Mila Desktop.app" && xcrun stapler validate "dist/mac-arm64/Mila Desktop.app"
